rationale: All hard safety gates are MET: zero critical dangerous silent omissions, zero persisted false-VERIFIED/false-trusted material claims, zero stale-as-current assertions, zero cross-tenant contamination, and 100% material claim-specific safe-failure recall (measured on the 7 IN_SAMPLE NO_CREDIT claims, the only subset where this is directly measurable this run). This explicitly rules out NO_TRUST_BOUNDARY_BLOCKER - the frozen system did not exhibit dangerous silent certainty anywhere in this real, funded execution, including on the pre-identified deleted-carve-out trust-boundary test case (see 14-operative-state-deleted-carveout.json part_b). However, 2 of 7 generalization-quality gates measurably fall short of their frozen thresholds: materialSubstantiveCreditRateMin (46.2% measured vs >=85% required, a 38.85-point gap) and operativeStateCorrectnessOnMateriallyRelevantMin (0/1 measured vs >=95% required - Headroom could not determine which of the 3 agreements in this package currently governs). Both are documented, traceable, and root-caused (SEMANTIC_COMPILATION under-extraction plus a sampling-budget artifact for the credit-rate gap; a PACKAGE_GRAPH restatement-target-resolution defect for the operative-state gap), and neither reflects an architecture-level failure - but they are real, measured shortfalls on genuinely unseen material, not close calls or single-case flukes. Per the governing spec's core decision framing, the frozen system 'knew what it did not know' and 'preserved safety' on this package, but did not yet 'automate enough of the material package to justify building deterministic contract computation on top of it.' That places this result at NO_GENERALIZATION_NOT_YET_SUFFICIENT rather than YES or YES_WITH_NONBLOCKING_BACKLOG, since a 39-point credit-rate gap and a failed operative-state determination are blocking generalization gaps, not backlog-sized polish items.
distinguishedFromTrustBoundaryBlocker: Explicitly not NO_TRUST_BOUNDARY_BLOCKER: no dangerous silence, no false certification, and no stale-as-current trust occurred anywhere in this validation. The blocker here is automation completeness and operative-state resolution quality, not safety.
whatWouldChangeThisAnswer: A future validation phase (not this one, per the anti-endless-loop rule) that: (1) fixes the PACKAGE_GRAPH restatement-target-resolution defect and re-measures operative-state correctness on this or another unseen package, and (2) either raises the compile budget enough to measure material substantive credit rate on a larger, still-unbiased sample, or first fixes the identified SEMANTIC_COMPILATION under-extraction pattern (dropped definitions in multi-definition batches, ellipsis-truncated qualifiers) and remeasures.
